candidate_sentences.text: During the financial year 2025, Impero A/S achieved a resilient performance despite macroeconomic and geopolitical headwinds, ending the period with annual recurring revenue reaching 46.2 million Danish kroner, which represented a 19 percent year-on-year growth rate.

EBITDA ended at negative 3.1 million Danish kroner, representing a substantial improvement from negative 8.7 million Danish kroner in 2024 and landing in the better end of the revised guidance range of negative 5 million to negative 3 million Danish kroner.

verified_key_information_units.information: The company maintained exceptionally low churn of 1% in 2025 and achieved a Net Revenue Retention Rate (NRR) of 106%, with Average ARR per Account (ARPA) reaching a record DKK 228T.

verified_key_information_units.information: Impero surpassed 200 customers by end-2025, with customer base diversification (40% of Danish C25 index and 22.5% of German DAX index) and reduced top-10 customer concentration to 20% of ARR.

candidate_sentences.text: Impero also surpassed the milestone of 200 customers during the period and improved customer concentration among its top 10 customers, which decreased to 20 percent of total ARR by year-end.

verified_key_information_units.information: Growth was driven primarily by Denmark (22% YoY net new ARR growth) and DACH region (26% YoY growth, 44% of total ARR), with strategic expansion planned for UK, Nordics, and Benelux markets.

candidate_sentences.text: Growth was driven by platform expansion within the existing customer base, new product features, and solid performances in core markets, with Denmark and the DACH region growing net new ARR by 22 percent and 26 percent, respectively.

verified_key_information_units.information: Key product milestones included launch of Control Testing module, AI-augmented engineering adoption, and initiation of Entity Management development planned for 2026.

candidate_sentences.text: Own work capitalized increased to 5.2 million Danish kroner from 3.6 million Danish kroner due to a heightened focus on developing new platform features such as the control testing module and entity management.

candidate_sentences.text: Total cash and cash equivalents increased significantly to 18.9 million Danish kroner as of 31 December 2025, up from 9.8 million Danish kroner at the end of 2024.
This was primarily bolstered by a directed share issue that raised 15 million Danish kroner in December 2025, alongside proceeds from warrant exercises.

Following the capital injection and continued solid SaaS metrics, the Board of Directors concluded that growth investments would create greater long-term shareholder value than pursuing the prior goal of achieving recurring positive cash flow before the end of 2026.

verified_key_information_units.information: The Board accelerated commercial investments for 2026 (including new hires) to increase ARR growth, expecting ARR of DKK 53-57M (+15-23% YoY) but EBITDA of DKK -2M to -1M due to higher costs.

candidate_sentences.text: Following the capital injection and continued solid SaaS metrics, the Board of Directors concluded that growth investments would create greater long-term shareholder value than pursuing the prior goal of achieving recurring positive cash flow before the end of 2026.

For the full year 2026, Impero expects ARR to reach between 53 million and 57 million Danish kroner, reflecting an anticipated growth rate of approximately 15 percent to 23 percent, and projects EBITDA to be in the range of negative 2 million to positive 1 million Danish kroner.

details.completeness_justification: All HIGH importance criteria (K1-K7) are adequately represented in the candidate summary with core material meaning present. K8 (MEDIUM importance) is missing entirely - there is no mention of partner network expansion in DACH or the 71% new ARR from own channel. The overall coverage is strong for HIGH items, but the missing MEDIUM item prevents a perfect score. The main picture of financial performance, growth drivers, metrics, and future plans is well captured.
details.coherence_justification: The candidate summary is fully coherent internally. All statements are logically connected without contradictions. The narrative flows from overall performance to specific metrics (revenue, ARR, churn, profitability), then to cash flow and capital structure, and finally to strategic guidance for 2026. Explanations (e.g., growth drivers, cost management) logically support the results described. There is no unnecessary repetition, and the organization groups related information effectively (e.g., financial metrics in S3-S10, cash flow in S13-S15, strategic shifts in S17-S18). The summary forms a clear, self-contained story with no internal inconsistencies.
